messages:
maria: Customer Acme-Health escalated: tool results are being associated with the wrong tool when using parallel tool calls. They see vision labels attached to NER results and vice versa.

maria: Repro payload we used (simplified):
```
POST /v1/call
{
  "input": "annotate image and extract entities",
  "tools": ["vision:label", "ner:extract"],
  "parallel": true,
  "callback_id": "cb-12345"
}
```

maria: Observed API response (swapped):
```
{
  "outputs": [
    {"tool": "ner:extract", "result": "labels: cat, tree"},
    {"tool": "vision:label", "result": "entities: Cat (animal)"}
  ]
}
```

sanjay: can you paste request_id / trace id and customer org so we can correlate logs? pinging @eng-oncall

maria: request_id=rid_0a9f, org=acme-health, trace=trace-9c7

julie: @eng-oncall fyi — this smells like an ordering/mapping regression after the dispatcher tweak last week. :eyes:

eng-bot: Deploybot: rollout tool-dispatcher v2.7.4 -> prod completed 2026-03-02T18:22Z

tim: Quick theory: mapping uses the original tool index array position but worker responses arrive out-of-order. If we attach results by index instead of an explicit tool_result id, parallel=true will break.

sanjay: trying to reproduce locally with a flood test. small script:
```
for i in 1..200:
  POST /v1/call parallel=true tools=[A,B,C]
```
observed: ~15% of responses had mismatched tool->result pairing, sometimes duplicate result ids.
```

maria: Added relevant dispatcher logs:
```
DEBUG map_results: assigned result_id=rid_0a9f to tool_index=0
DEBUG recv worker-2 result_id=rid_0a9f tool=ner:extract
```

tim: That looks like result_id reuse across workers. Maybe short id space (6 chars) + high concurrency -> collisions. Also could be a bug in the result_id assignment path where we reuse a pool buffer.

julie: For immediate mitigation we can disable parallel dispatch for the customer and roll back v2.7.4 if needed. Ops, can you toggle config for org=acme-health?

ops: rolling config change to disable parallel dispatch for org=acme-health now (set parallel=false at routing layer). ETA ~3m :spinner:

ops: done — change propagated to edge in ~2m. Customer reports fewer mismatches but still a couple of bad responses.

sanjay: I'll add high-fidelity logging in dispatcher: record assigned result_id, worker_id, tool_name, and final array position. Then re-run stress tests. If it's id collision we should see same result_id from different workers nearly simultaneously.

maria: Support ticket 4442 updated with repro steps, logs, and mitigation steps. Customer assigned to CS rep @julie for updates.

support_bot: Ticket 4442 updated. Notified customer-success.

julie: Next actions: (1) eng-runtime pair to investigate id generator / buffer reuse, (2) consider switching to explicit tool_result tokens that carry tool_name so final assembly doesn't rely on array ordering, (3) rollout patch behind a feature flag and test with Acme.Health.

tim: I'll file a PR to change result id generation to UUIDv4 and add unit tests for concurrent assignment. Also add an invariant check in assembler: assert(result.tool_name == requested_tools[slot]) in debug mode.

sanjay: assigning ticket to eng-runtime queue ENG-7643 and will link logs.

maria: customer notified of mitigation and ETA. Thank you all. :heart:
